title: Watch: Why has UK diesel price hit an all time high?
description: Diesel has now hit an average of £2 a litre in the UK, the RAC motoring group says, with petrol prices also rising.

title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
description: More than 600 schools have faced disruption as protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.

title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
description: The woman, known as Jane Doe, alleges she was raped by seven students at a fraternity house at the university in 2024.

title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
description: Vitaliy Klitschko says Ukraine's capital is in a "very dramatic situation" as Russia hits critical infrastructure.

title: I've seen nearly 500 executions - but never one like Christa Pike's
description: Texas reporter Michael Graczyk has seen botched executions in his time, but not one in which an inmate survived.

title: Dolly Parton sings Jolene in Welsh in recording released after her death
description: Parton's niece Jada Star and Welsh singer Bronwen Lewis say the country artist was proud to sing in Welsh.

title: Watch: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
description: He has been hailed a hero for opening the cockpit door, allowing passengers to overpower his co-pilot.

title: Alison Hammond has heart check-up in hospital after leaving TV's This Morning
description: The host says she is "fine" but getting checked after leaving midway through Friday's This Morning.

title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
description: The defeat raises pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election, after a series of scandals affecting his party and allies.
